literature_searches: Web searches on 2026-11-14 for each of the seven hosts by catalogue names (CGCG 539-025, IRAS 02237+4127, PGC 9307; ESO 161-23, IRAS 06431-5551; UGC 2653, MCG+06-08-012, IRAS 03154+3725; IRAS 21102-8100 and the 2MASX names of the others) with 'flare', 'transient', 'tidal disruption' found no report of these events.
hash_note: SHA-256 of the files as stored in Git (LF line endings).
